$comment: App Privacy label source for App Store Connect record 6787265352 (ExcerLock, sku excerlock-ios-001). Every entry names the code that proves it. guardrails/release/privacy-manifest.test.ts checks the evidence paths exist and that every analytics.track() event in the app is listed. docs/release/app-privacy.md is the human-readable derivation and the exact answers to enter.

dataTypes.note: Email sign-in code (Supabase) and the support reply address sent to the VPS /v1/support route. Sign in with Apple may hand over a relay address.
The onboarding name stays in the on-device profile store; SyncPort pushes rules, rule days, earned unlocks and history only.

Running and cycling minutes or distance read from HealthKit become RuleDay.progress, which syncs to the VPS as backup (P2-T08). HealthKit-derived values are never sent to PostHog, Sentry or Adapty (Apple HealthKit rules; the analytics privacy policy drops undeclared keys).
Core Motion step totals and walking minutes become RuleDay.progress and sync to the VPS. Cadence and gait verification stay on the device.

Gym coordinates, geofence presence and GymVisit rows never leave the device; P2-T08's type-level test forbids gym names and coordinates in sync payloads. The gym_unlock_tapped event carries a distance in metres, not a coordinate.
PostHog GeoIP is off (ported policy from app/src/analytics); Sentry runs with sendDefaultPii false.
Gym search queries go from the device to Apple MapKit Local Search; ExcerLock's servers never receive them and nothing is stored.
Treadmill framing frames are processed on the iPhone and never recorded or sent.
One identity spine: Supabase user id = VPS users.id = Adapty customer_user_id = PostHog distinct_id, from the anonymous session onward.
PostHog's $device_id buckets feature flags (decision D8); Sentry records an installation id with each crash. Neither is the IDFA; no AppTrackingTransparency prompt exists.
Adapty holds the subscription state and transaction history keyed by the Supabase uid; its webhook mirrors the state to the VPS; Adapty's PostHog integration owns the lifecycle events (decision D9).
PostHog screen views (fixed FlowScreen registry only) and the events listed under analyticsEvents. Autocapture, session replay, surveys, heatmaps and exception autocapture are off.

Minutes of shielded-app use per day (5-minute resolution) sync to the VPS as usage_days. App identities never leave the device: the Screen Time selection is an opaque token and is not synced (decision D5).
Sentry (org edge-ix, project excerlock-mobile) with the ported scrub and sendDefaultPii false. Flip linkedToUser to true if P2-T07 calls Sentry.setUser with the uid.
Sentry tracing and profiling are not enabled. Flip to collected if P2-T07 turns them on.
A support request carries app version and build, iOS version, device model, permission statuses, rule count and the last enforcement result, next to the reply email.
Rules (activity, goal, schedule) sync to the VPS as backup. The onboarding answers ageBand, occupation, improveFirst and mainReason become PostHog person properties (P2-T07 amendment).
